record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the pointwise positive/negative logistic loss with pairwise BPR: softplus(neg_score - pos_score), averaged over existing nonpadding target positions. Directly optimizing the positive-negative margin may improve candidate ranking relative to independently calibrating both scores. Keep sampled negatives, position weighting, features, embeddings, NextItNet topology, readout, optimizer and training schedule unchanged.
record.diff_excerpt:
--- 
+++ 
@@ -156,5 +156,5 @@
     pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
     mask = (pos != 0).float()
-    loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+    loss = nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
     return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

category_rationales.rationale: Apply pairwise BPR across all four datasets to optimize positive-negative ranking margins, retaining the existing global mean over nonpadding targets and all other training and inference settings.
